product_wide_rationale: It carries the priorities.md Appendix A conflict rules and the authority to change Product law, which bind every child Domain and every law record, so no single child Domain can own it.
summary: One validated contract table holds every priorities.md Appendix A rule with its enforcing mechanism or a listed gap, and applying a rule leaves a record. Law changes and operator consent follow CD-0243's six classes; changes to the approval boundary require exact-text operator approval. Seriousness, Domain count, crucial size, and a missing classification do not independently require approval. The RTE coordinates dependencies, and operator decisions go directly to the operator. Operator-free law revisions remain derived. Recovery and permanent loss follow CD-0243 D5. Follow-up items carry a rule label in Linear; six-class runtime alignment remains an implementation obligation.
title: The conflict rules are one checked table, and law changes follow the operator's approval boundary
